sections.heading: Founder & Director
body: I started iFranchise with a simple belief: every entrepreneur deserves a fair shot at building something extraordinary. Too many brilliant business ideas die not from lack of potential, but from lack of the right guidance, capital, and strategic support.

We're not just connecting brands with investors - we're building dreams into empires. Every franchise we validate, every partnership we forge, and every expansion we architect is driven by one mission: turning your vision into a legacy that outlasts us all.
Your success is our legacy. Let's build something India will remember.

Scaling isn't just about opening more locations. It's about building systems so strong that your brand can thrive in 100 cities without losing its soul. It's about creating frameworks that turn chaos into clarity, and ambition into achievement.

We don't just advise - we roll up our sleeves and build alongside you. From market validation to operational excellence, we're in the trenches with every partner, ensuring no detail is overlooked and no opportunity is wasted.
Your growth is our obsession. Let's turn your brand into an unstoppable force.

faqs.question: How do I franchise my business?
faqs.answer: To franchise your business in India, start by validating unit economics, documenting standard operating procedures, defining your franchise model (FOFO, FOCO, or FICO), and preparing legal franchise agreements. iFranchise supports franchise development end-to-end — from franchise consulting and model design to investor-ready listing on our franchise marketplace. List your brand to get a structured readiness review and a clear path to franchise expansion.

faqs.question: How much does franchise development cost?
faqs.answer: Franchise development costs vary by industry, model complexity, and documentation depth. Typical investments include legal structuring, operations manuals, training systems, marketing collateral, and franchise consulting. iFranchise helps brands scope franchise development realistically and align spend with franchise growth goals. Submit your brand details for a tailored assessment — many brands begin with listing and consulting before full-scale rollout.

faqs.question: How do I find franchise investors?
faqs.answer: Franchise investors discover opportunities through franchise listing platforms, franchise consultants, referrals, and structured outreach. iFranchise connects your brand with serious franchise investors searching our franchise ecosystem by ticket size, sector, geography, and operating model. A live franchise opportunity profile improves franchise lead generation and positions your brand for qualified franchise partner acquisition.

faqs.question: How can I promote my franchise opportunity?
faqs.answer: Promote your franchise opportunity with an investor-grade listing, clear unit economics, compelling brand narrative, and visibility across India's franchise marketplace. iFranchise provides national brand exposure, franchise consulting support, and distribution to entrepreneurs researching franchise opportunities. Combined with SEO-optimized franchise listing content, your opportunity becomes discoverable on Google Search and AI platforms like ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, and Perplexity.

faqs.question: Can I list my brand on iFranchise?
faqs.answer: Yes. Brand owners with an operational business model can list on iFranchise — India's franchise growth platform for franchise expansion, franchise investors, and franchise partner acquisition. Submit your brand through the listing form on this page. Our team evaluates franchise readiness and guides you through onboarding to the franchise listing platform.

faqs.question: What industries can be franchised?
faqs.answer: Most scalable businesses can be franchised — food and beverage, retail, education, health and wellness, home services, technology, and more. What matters is replicable operations, documented processes, and viable unit economics. iFranchise works with ambitious brands across industries; we do not limit listings to specific sectors. If your model can scale through franchise partnerships, you can explore listing on our franchise marketplace.

faqs.question: What is included in a premium listing?
faqs.answer: A premium franchise listing on iFranchise includes structured brand profiling, franchise opportunity presentation, visibility to franchise investors on our marketplace, franchise lead generation support, and access to franchise consulting guidance on expansion strategy. Brands benefit from national exposure within the iFranchise franchise ecosystem, helping accelerate franchise growth and serious investor conversations.

title: Frequently asked questions
intro: Everything founders, investors, and future team members need to know about franchise growth on iFranchise.

faqs.question: What is iFranchise?
faqs.answer: iFranchise is an India-based franchise consulting and marketplace platform. We help investors discover verified franchise business opportunities and help brands expand through investor matching, franchise development, and growth advisory.

faqs.question: How does iFranchise help franchise investors?
faqs.answer: Investors can browse verified franchise listings, compare investment range, business model (FOFO, FOCO, FICO), payback, and expansion cities, then enquire directly for franchise consulting support and brand introductions.

faqs.question: How does iFranchise help brand owners?
faqs.answer: Brands can list on iFranchise to reach qualified investors, generate franchise leads, prepare franchise documentation, and plan multi-city expansion across India with structured onboarding support.

faqs.question: What franchise consulting services does iFranchise offer?
faqs.answer: iFranchise offers franchise opportunity discovery, expansion strategy, investor matching, lead generation, franchise documentation, territory planning, and ongoing growth advisory for brands and investors in India.

faqs.question: Does iFranchise work with first-time franchise investors?
faqs.answer: Yes. Many partners are first-time operators. iFranchise helps compare models, understand unit economics, and connect with brands that provide structured onboarding, SOPs, and operational support.

faqs.question: Can iFranchise help my brand become franchise-ready?
faqs.answer: Yes. We support franchise model design, legal documentation, investor materials, lead generation, and post-launch advisory so brands can scale beyond their first few units.

faqs.question: Which industries does iFranchise cover?
faqs.answer: Food and beverage, retail, fashion, wellness, education, hospitality, and service franchises — with opportunities ranging from low-investment QSR formats to premium retail and hospitality concepts.

faqs.question: How much does it cost to start a franchise?
faqs.answer: Franchise investment varies by industry. Low-cost franchises (₹2–10 lakhs), mid-range (₹10–50 lakhs), premium (₹50 lakhs+). FOCO models often require 30–40% less capital than FOFO models.

faqs.question: What's the difference between FOCO, FOFO & FICO?
faqs.answer: FOCO: You invest, company operates. FOFO: You own and operate. FICO: Capital-focused with company-led operations. Each offers different risk-reward profiles and involvement levels.

faqs.question: Is franchise business profitable in India?
faqs.answer: Successful franchises typically achieve 15–25% net margins after stabilization. F&B shows ~18–30% gross margins, retail 25–40%, services 35–50% depending on brand strength and execution.

faqs.question: What legal documents are required?
faqs.answer: Core documents include FDD, Franchise Agreement, Trademark License, Operations Manual, and Territory Rights, along with GST registration, FSSAI license (for F&B), and local permits.

faqs.question: How long does it take to launch a franchise?
faqs.answer: Most brands go from agreement to launch in 3–6 months, including due diligence, documentation, site selection, fit-out, training, and soft launch preparation.

faqs.question: What is the typical investment range?
faqs.answer: Most opportunities on our platform start around ₹20L and can go beyond ₹2.5Cr depending on brand category, ticket size, and market depth.

faqs.question: How long does it take to break even?
faqs.answer: Break-even timelines vary by sector, but many franchise models we work with target 12–24 months with disciplined execution and working capital planning.

faqs.question: Do I need prior business experience?
faqs.answer: Not necessarily. Many successful partners are first-time operators who rely on structured onboarding, SOPs, and advisory support from the brand and iFranchise.

faqs.question: What support does iFranchise provide?
faqs.answer: We support brand matching, diligence, financial understanding, launch planning, and ongoing growth guidance after onboarding.

faqs.answer: Yes. Multi-unit expansion is available for many brands after performance milestones and market readiness checks are met.

title: Privacy Notice

sections.heading: Status of this notice
body: REQUIRES LEGAL REVIEW. This notice is a technical draft based on processing visible in the website code. It is not a legal certification. The registered legal entity operating under the iFranchise name, the applicable processing grounds, retention schedule, grievance contact, processor contracts, cross-border processing details, and the commencement of applicable DPDP Act and Rules provisions require confirmation.

sections.heading: Where this notice applies
body: This notice describes personal-data handling visible on the iFranchise website when a person submits an enquiry, requests a franchise brochure, expresses interest in a franchise, applies to list a brand, applies for a role, requests data-principal assistance, or chooses to use analytics preferences and external contact links.

sections.heading: Personal data collected
body: Depending on the form, the website may collect a name, email address, telephone number, company or brand details, state, city, preferred location, franchise or investment interests, enquiry message, job role, resume link, portfolio link, and request details. The form pipeline also attaches the source page, page URL, path, referrer, and submission timestamp. The website does not currently provide user accounts, collect passwords, accept direct resume uploads, or implement a payment-card form.

sections.heading: Purposes visible in the implementation
body: The collected information is used to receive and respond to contact and advisory enquiries, evaluate brand applications, handle interest in a named franchise, provide requested brochures, evaluate job applications, receive data-rights requests, prevent basic form abuse, operate the website, and measure website and form performance when analytics is permitted. Any additional use, including promotional email, SMS, telephone or WhatsApp marketing, requires business and legal confirmation and an appropriate separate choice where required.

sections.heading: How form data is handled
body: Submitted form information is validated and sanitised in the browser and sent over HTTPS to a Google Apps Script endpoint that appends it to a form-specific Google Sheets tab. When lead notifications are enabled in the deployment configuration, a Vercel serverless endpoint and Resend may also process a copy for an internal notification email. Google Sheet ownership, authorised users, email recipients, access-review procedures, backup practices, and storage regions are not established by this code and require business confirmation.

sections.heading: Franchise enquiries and other recipients
body: A franchise enquiry identifies the franchise in which the person expressed interest. The code stores that context with the enquiry. Whether identifiable enquiry data is subsequently shared with the relevant franchise brand, and under what controls, is an operational fact requiring business and legal confirmation. The code also contains user-initiated links to WhatsApp/Meta, Cal.com, Google Maps, telephone, email and social-sharing services; information entered after leaving the website is handled under the selected service’s own terms and privacy practices.

sections.heading: Analytics, cookies and device storage
body: The website uses first-party local or session storage for theme preference, scroll restoration, knowledge-hub progress, and the analytics-consent choice. Google Tag Manager and Google Analytics are intended to receive page and conversion events only after analytics consent. The exact tags in the live GTM container, GA4 settings, cookie names, retention settings, advertising features, and any additional pixels require a live configuration review. Analytics consent can be changed using the “Privacy choices” control in the website footer.

sections.heading: Retention
body: REQUIRES LEGAL REVIEW. The code does not define or enforce a retention period for Google Sheets rows, internal notification emails, data-rights requests, analytics data, or third-party services. No automated deletion or anonymisation job exists. The business must approve a purpose-specific retention schedule and operational deletion procedure before a definite period can be stated here.

sections.heading: Security controls and limitations
body: The implementation uses HTTPS endpoint validation, client-side field validation, payload sanitisation, honeypot fields, size limits, duplicate in-flight submission controls, and selected HTTP security headers. Access controls for Google Sheets and vendor systems are operational rather than defined in this repository. No internet service can be represented as completely secure, and this draft does not claim that security assessments, encryption at rest, or processor controls have been independently verified.

sections.heading: Data-principal requests
body: REQUIRES LEGAL REVIEW. Subject to applicable and commenced law, a person may request information about processing, access-related information, correction, completion or updating, erasure, withdrawal of consent where consent applies, and grievance handling. Submit a request through the Data Rights Request form or contact contact@ifranchise.in. Identity and request authority may need to be verified before any personal data is disclosed, changed or erased. The website does not automatically expose stored personal data.

sections.heading: Withdrawing consent
body: REQUIRES LEGAL REVIEW. Analytics consent can be rejected or withdrawn through the website privacy choices. For a previously submitted form, use the Data Rights Request form or the contact details below and identify the form or enquiry involved. Withdrawal does not itself determine whether information must be retained for another confirmed legal requirement; that assessment requires an internal verified process.

sections.heading: Children
body: REQUIRES LEGAL REVIEW. The website and franchise investment services are presented for adults, and the Terms state an age threshold of 18. The forms do not currently perform age or parental-authority verification. The business and counsel must confirm whether any child-data processing is possible and what prevention or verifiable-consent controls are required.

sections.heading: Changes to this notice
body: REQUIRES LEGAL REVIEW. This notice should be versioned when processing or legal requirements change. Material changes affecting consent should be presented for a fresh choice where required. A legal effective date must be approved rather than inferred solely from the website deployment date.

migrationNote: Original source draft. Update implementation-specific terms for CRM migration and retain draft status pending business/legal approval; do not publish outdated Google Sheets/Resend claims.

title: Careers at iFranchise
intro: Build with a team connecting brands, investors, and growth.

jobs.title: Business Development Trainee
jobs.tagline: Identify and onboard brands, build relationships with business leaders, and grow iFranchise through hands-on business development.
keySkills: Bachelor's or Master's in Business, Marketing, Commerce, or related fields
Comfortable speaking with founders, CEOs, and business owners
jobs.whyJoin: Attractive performance-based incentives for every brand successfully onboarded, practical exposure to sales and franchise consulting, direct interaction with founders and CEOs, work on real expansion projects, and a path to a full-time Business Development Executive role after a successful 6-month internship.
jobs.about: iFranchise is a growing franchise development and business expansion platform that helps brands scale through strategic franchise partnerships. We work closely with emerging and established brands to support their growth and market expansion objectives.
jobs.aboutRole: We are looking for a highly motivated and energetic Business Development Trainee to identify and onboard brands, build relationships with business leaders, and promote iFranchise services. This role offers hands-on exposure to business development, sales strategy, client acquisition, and franchise consulting—with structured training and mentorship throughout the internship.
responsibilities: Research and identify brands suitable for franchise development and expansion
Engage growth-focused brands and open meaningful partnership discussions
Present iFranchise services and schedule meetings with senior management
Follow up with prospects and support brand onboarding through the full cycle
requirements: Self-motivated, target-driven, and eager to learn
Basic knowledge of sales and business development (preferred)
jobs.applyNote: Submit your resume with a brief introduction highlighting your interest in business development and client acquisition. You can also reach us on LinkedIn.

jobs.title: Asst. Business Development Manager (Franchise Expansion)
jobs.stipend: Competitive Fixed Salary + Performance Incentives + Travel Reimbursements
jobs.tagline: Lead brand acquisition and franchise expansion—own the full BD cycle from outreach to onboarding across India.
keySkills: 3–6 years in BD, B2B sales, franchise sales, or brand partnerships
Proven track record of client acquisition and closing deals
Strong communication, presentation, and negotiation skills
jobs.whyJoin: Work with India’s growing brands and entrepreneurs, build a strong network of business leaders, contribute directly to company growth, performance-driven culture with substantial earning potential, competitive salary with incentives for every successful brand onboarded, travel allowance for official business travel, and fast-track progression into senior leadership.
jobs.about: iFranchise is a leading franchise consulting and business expansion company helping brands scale through strategic franchise development, partner acquisition, and growth-focused expansion solutions. We work directly with founders, CEOs, and business leaders across India to build scalable franchise networks.
jobs.aboutRole: We are looking for a dynamic Asst. Business Development Manager to lead brand acquisition and franchise expansion. Ideal candidates are based in the NCR region, love networking and travel, and want to own the complete cycle—from identifying brands and engaging founders/CEOs to onboarding them on iFranchise.
responsibilities: Drive franchise sales and onboard brands onto the iFranchise platform
Identify and engage franchise investors and business buyers
Manage the full sales cycle from outreach to deal closure
Match investors with suitable franchise brands and support onboarding
Travel for client meetings, presentations, and industry events
requirements: Self-driven, target-oriented, and comfortable owning outcomes
Passion for networking, travel, and in-person client meetings
Entrepreneurial mindset with strong ownership and confidence
jobs.applyNote: Submit your resume with a brief introduction highlighting your experience in business development, franchise sales, and client acquisition. You can also apply via LinkedIn.

process.heading: Application Review
body: We review every application within 5 business days.

process.heading: Intro Call
body: 20-minute call with the hiring manager to align on fit and expectations.

process.heading: Skills / Strategy Round
body: A focused assessment - portfolio review, case study, or live task depending on the role.

process.heading: Leadership Round
body: Final conversation with a founder or department head.

process.heading: Offer
body: Fast turnaround. We move quickly for the right people.
